title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1971-04-07
source: Source: sbd > master reel > pcm > dolby A decoded dat > pcm (Sony beta HG) - recorded by Betty Cantor and provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: pcm > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/44.1 - transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Recording quality not specified, but the show is described as dynamite with an exciting post‑drums jam that unfortunately gets cut short.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the overall energy of this performance, calling it "dynamite" and praising a powerful jam after the drum solo. However, one reviewer notes that the best part of the set— the jam following the drums— is abruptly truncated, which detracts from an otherwise high‑energy show.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (5 and 4 stars) indicating a strong musical performance, but the missing jam segment prevents a higher rating; recording quality is not discussed, limiting confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound source or audio clarity were provided in the reviews.
